topics.topic: A 45-year-old woman with a 3-year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, inadequately controlled on metformin, presents for evaluation. Her most recent HbA1c is 8.2%. She has no history of type 1 diabetes and is not pregnant.

A 52-year-old woman is diagnosed with histologically confirmed metastatic HER2-negative breast cancer. Her ECOG performance status is 1. She has not previously been treated with Drug Y and has no known brain metastases.
A 9-year-old boy with a two-year history of persistent asthma is being evaluated for enrollment in an observational registry. He has no history of cystic fibrosis.
